pi1_resumen: No context-restoration technique is proposed. The agent receives the full dialogue with the simulated user (p.5 Sec.4).
pi2_resumen: No dialogue-state method is proposed. The full interaction history stays in the context, and the paper analyses dialogue length (Fig.4, Fig.11).
pi3_resumen: No schema linking or join inference. The full DDL is provided and the model works it out implicitly. The benchmark's tree-structure transformation uses foreign keys only to build tasks.

limitaciones_autores: Task instruction complexity is limited by LLM context windows. Automated filtering avoided large-scale ensemble voting for cost reasons.

pi1_resumen: No propone técnica de restauración de contexto. En SParC/CoSQL solo se parafrasea la última pregunta y los turnos previos quedan intactos (p.4 §2.1).
pi2_resumen: No propone gestión del estado del diálogo. El contexto previo se conserva sin cambios para preservar el estado y el grounding (p.4 §2.1).
pi3_resumen: No hay técnica de linking. Un análisis cualitativo de errores comprueba que las paráfrasis conservan los anclajes léxicos del esquema y que los fallos no vienen de un linking roto (p.8-9 §5, Fig. 6).
pi4_resumen: No hay retroalimentación de ejecución ni autocorrección; la ejecución solo se usa para calcular la exactitud (p.1 Abstract).
limitaciones_autores: Solo 4 benchmarks públicos; paráfrasis generadas por LLM con posibles sesgos; EX mezcla fuentes de error; en multiturno se parafrasea solo el último turno; el gradiente temporal es correlacional; no se evalúan sistemas especializados en SQL; τ no establece causalidad.

venue: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
pi1_resumen: The full dialogue history (previous questions and SQL) is given to the policy together with the current question and schema; there is no explicit rewriting or resolution module. p.3 §3.1.
pi2_resumen: A persistent memory stores previous questions, SQL and parsed constraints. The agent calls it to check that its SQL is coherent across turns (M-VERIFY). p.3 §3.1; p.15 App. C.
pi3_resumen: There is no explicit linking module; the full schema is placed in the prompt and joins are inferred by the LLM. Error analysis with an LLM judge includes Schema Linking and Join Path categories. p.9 §4.4.
pi4_resumen: The agent proposes SQL, executes it, then verifies the execution result and the coherence with memory. It refines the SQL until both pass, up to 4 tool interactions. Ablation: removing Execute or Memory-Verify lowers EX. p.3-4; p.8 Table 3.
limitaciones_autores: Residual Aggregation Drift errors and unresolved extra-hard cases; higher latency and token usage than baselines may limit real-time use.

venue: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
pi1_resumen: Reescribe cada pregunta con M-schema para reducir su dependencia del contexto. Calcula un puntaje GDS (reducción de perplejidad × cercanía temporal) para elegir el ancla contextual relevante. (p.3 §2.3)
pi2_resumen: El Role-State es un vector binario de 10 roles SQL por turno. Se verifican trayectorias de entrenamiento mediante isomorfismo de Role-States entre el ancla histórica y la actual, y se usan como guía en el prompt. (p.3-5 §2.2, 2.4)
pi3_resumen: El linking es parte del razonamiento del LLM: asigna roles funcionales (select, join, condition, etc.) a elementos del esquema como plano estructural antes de generar el SQL. Los joins no usan inferencia algorítmica. (p.2-3 §2.2, Fig.2)
pi4_resumen: No hay mecanismo de retroalimentación de ejecución ni autocorrección; la generación es una sola decodificación voraz. (p.5 §3)
limitaciones_autores: Tres limitaciones: escasez de trayectorias estructuralmente compatibles en patrones raros o dominios especializados; Role-State ligero que no cubre SQL open-domain más rico; sobrecarga de inferencia por trayectorias y razonamiento explícito. (p.12 Limitations)

modelos_base: GPT-5; GPT-4o; GPT-4.1; Grok-3 Mini Fast; LLaMA-3.3
pi1_resumen: No propone una técnica de restauración de contexto. Los LLM reciben el diálogo completo de aclaración y deben producir el SQL resuelto (p.5 §4.2).
pi2_resumen: No hay representación de estado propia: el historial se pasa completo al LLM. Los diálogos son cortos, de una ronda de aclaración según los ejemplos (p.12 Tabla 12).
pi3_metricas_linking: Match Accuracy (MA) de AmbiSQL: mide si la ambigüedad predicha se alinea con los elementos de esquema de referencia (Col-amb uni: Spider 57.8, BIRD 50.1; multi: Spider 20.4, BIRD 5.4)
pi3_resumen: La detección de ambigüedad es casi perfecta (DA ~99-100) pero la localización en el esquema (MA) es mucho menor, sobre todo en casos multifaceta (p.7 Tablas 6-7). Es un resultado diagnóstico, no una técnica.
pi4_resumen: El benchmark modela aclaraciones del usuario (concisas, verbosas, parciales, no útiles) y casos no respondibles donde se debe devolver Null. Los LLM resuelven mejor los casos no respondibles que los ambiguos (p.6 §5, Tablas 5 y 20).
limitaciones_autores: No hay sección de limitaciones. Se excluyen las categorías de ambigüedad de valor de la evaluación de predicción de SQL por ser impracticable exponer el contenido de la BD. Los metadatos solo se usan en contexto, no en la prueba. El trabajo futuro menciona cambios de tema y la incertidumbre del usuario.

pi1_resumen: Concatena feedback, explicación del análisis inicial, pregunta y esquema, y los enlaza con relaciones codificadas a mano (coincidencia léxica, referencias a pasos) en un transformer sensible a relaciones. La explicación sustituye al SQL inicial como entrada. Ubic.: p.3-4 Sec.4.1-4.2.
pi2_resumen: El estado es el SQL inicial, que se modifica con ediciones a nivel de cláusula. No hay estado de diálogo a lo largo de varios turnos; se evalúa una sola ronda. Ubic.: p.2-3 Sec.3, p.9 Sec.9.
pi3_resumen: Se enlazan feedback, explicación y pregunta con el esquema por coincidencia de nombres y valores y relaciones de RAT-SQL. No se evalúa el linking de forma aislada; los fallos de enlace son la fuente dominante de error restante. Ubic.: p.4 Sec.4.2; p.7 Sec.7.2.
pi4_resumen: El usuario revisa la explicación del SQL inicial y da una frase de feedback; el modelo predice ediciones que se aplican al análisis inicial. Se evalúa una sola ronda de corrección. Ubic.: p.1 Fig.1; p.9 Sec.9.
limitaciones_autores: El modelo falla con feedback largo que reescribe la consulta, con muchos errores a la vez (tamaño de edición >2) y al enlazar el feedback con el esquema. Se generaliza peor al mejorar el analizador (la ganancia cae de +20,3 a +4,3). La localización de errores en consultas complejas es el cuello de botella.

titulo: Decoupled Dialogue Modeling and Semantic Parsing for Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL
autores: Chen, Z.; Chen, L.; Li, H.; Cao, R.; Ma, D.; Wu, M.; Yu, K.
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL-IJCNLP 2021
pi1_resumen: A pretrained BART rewrites the current utterance, given the concatenated dialogue history, into a self-contained question. The rewriter is improved with dual learning (rewriter/simplifier) on unlabeled dialogues. p.2-5 §2.1, §3.
pi2_resumen: No explicit dialogue state is kept. Context is encoded only as the rewritten question, and the full history is concatenated as input to the rewriter. p.3 §3.1.
pi3_resumen: Schema linking is delegated to the off-the-shelf RAT-SQL parser, which uses a relation-aware Transformer over question-schema graph relations. Joins are inferred implicitly by the model. p.3 §2.2.
pi4_resumen: No inference-time execution feedback or self-correction. A training-time reward uses RAT-SQL output matching gold SQL, and user feedback on rewrites is only proposed as a possibility. p.5 §3.2.2, p.8 §4.3.
limitaciones_autores: No dedicated limitations section. Error analysis shows the rewrite model is the bottleneck after turn 3, especially for Continuation ellipsis and Demonstrative Pronoun, so more annotated rewrite data is needed. Without in-domain data, performance drops sharply (QM 42.1).

autores: Scholak, T.; Schucher, N.; Bahdanau, D.
venue: EMNLP 2021 - 2021 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, Proceedings
pi1_resumen: For CoSQL, previous questions in the interaction are appended in reverse chronological order to the input; inputs over 512 tokens are truncated. p.4 §3
pi2_resumen: Dialog state is just the flat concatenated previous questions fed to T5, bounded by 512-token truncation. p.4 §3
pi3_resumen: No separate linking module; schema is serialized into the input. PICARD guards reject columns not in the schema and tables not brought into scope. p.2-3 §2.1-2.3
pi4_resumen: Incremental parsing with lexing/parsing/guard modes rejects invalid tokens (score -inf) at each decoding step of beam search; no execution feedback. p.2-3 §2
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section; only notes additional checks (type checks, union/except/intersect column types) left to future work, and that restricted-to-finalization mode is less effective.

titulo: CHASE: A large-scale and pragmatic Chinese dataset for cross-database context-dependent text-to-SQL
autores: Guo, J.; Si, Z.; Wang, Y.; Liu, Q.; Fan, M.; Lou, J.-G.; Yang, Z.; Liu, T.
venue: ACL-IJCNLP 2021 - 59th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics and the 11th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing, Proceedings of the Conference
pi1_resumen: Baselines resolve context by concatenating previous questions (RAT-CON) or interaction-level encoders (EditSQL, IGSQL). The paper does not propose its own restoration technique. p.9 Sec.6.
pi2_resumen: Evaluates three existing neural baselines whose state is plain concatenated history (RAT-CON), the edited previous SQL (EditSQL), or a schema-item graph with history (IGSQL). The paper proposes no state mechanism of its own. p.9 Sec.6.
pi3_resumen: Schema-linking annotations are provided; mentions are 48% exact, 40% fuzzy and 12% semantic. RAT-CON's string-match linking performs poorly on CHASE. p.7-8.
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction is used.
limitaciones_autores: No dedicated limitations section. Authors note that approaches are tuned for English only and that CHASE covers only Chinese, with more languages left as future work. They also note a lack of context modeling methods that handle context-dependent questions.

autores: Chen, C.-Y.; Wang, P.-H.; Chang, S.-C.; Juan, D.-C.; Wei, W.; Pan, J.-Y.
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics Findings of ACL: EMNLP 2020
pi1_resumen: The whole dialogue history is encoded by a GRU and its last hidden state feeds the gate and SQL generator; no explicit rewriting or resolution. (p.3 §3.2)
pi2_resumen: A binary Dialogue State Tracker over the last encoder state decides when enough information exists to issue the SQL query (greeting vs problem-solving). Labels come from a rule-based annotation. (p.4 §3.3; p.6 §4.1)
pi3_escala_esquema: 1 tabla de KB (sin joins), 12 columnas + número de vuelo; KB aumentado hasta 70x (30 registros base, ~2100)
pi3_metricas_linking: Acc_col 98.96% (6 cond.)/97.24% (12 cond.); Acc_op 99.7/98.6; Acc_val 97.9/61.4; sin precisión/recall
pi3_resumen: Columns, operators and values of WHERE conditions are predicted by SQLNet-style classifiers using column-name encodings and the dialogue state. Single table with 12 attributes; no join inference. (p.4 §3.4)
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction; retrieved rows are encoded by a memory network. (p.4-5 §3.5)
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section; only notes weaker accuracy on the 6 less frequent conditions (time, class, price, airline) due to scarce data.

autores: Zhong, V.; Lewis, M.; Wang, S.I.; Zettlemoyer, L.
venue: EMNLP 2020 - 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, Proceedings of the Conference
pi1_resumen: The previous system-produced SQL is prefixed to the current utterance with [PREV]/[UTT] markers; no rewriting or explicit resolution. p.6 §3 Sparc/CoSQL.
pi2_resumen: Dialogue state is the previous predicted SQL query concatenated to the input. Context does not grow with turns. p.6 §3.
pi3_resumen: Schema is encoded table by table with BERT cross-encoding and BiLSTM/self-attention, and the pointer-decoder selects columns; no explicit linking or join inference. p.3 §2.2.
pi4_resumen: No inference-time execution feedback. The parser's output on a generated utterance is executed and compared with the sampled query's denotation to keep consistent examples for training. p.3-4 §2.4.
limitaciones_autores: No explicit limitations section; only future work (other domains such as robotics) is discussed. p.8 §5.

titulo: IGSQL: Database schema interaction graph based neural model for context-dependent text-to-SQL generation
autores: Cai, Y.; Wan, X.
venue: EMNLP 2020 - 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, Proceedings of the Conference
pi1_resumen: Historical user utterances are encoded with a BiLSTM plus an interaction LSTM with turn-level attention (as in EditSQL). The previously predicted SQL is encoded with a BiLSTM and attended to in the decoder. p.5 Sec.4.3-4.4.
pi2_resumen: Schema-item representations at turn i are updated by attention over the previous turn's schema representations (cross-turn layers, L1=2) and neighbours in the same turn (intra-turn layers, L2=1). A node is linked only to previous-turn nodes within distance 1. p.4-5 Sec.4.2.
pi3_resumen: The schema graph (nodes = table.column, edges = primary-foreign keys and same-table membership) encodes schema items. Co-attention between text and schema items is borrowed from EditSQL; no explicit linking or join inference. p.4-5 Sec.4.2-4.3.
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction mechanism is used.
limitaciones_autores: Only future work is mentioned: hard and extra-hard questions remain difficult. Ablations are run on dev sets only because the test sets are not public.

venue: COLING 2020 - 28th International Conference on Computational Linguistics, Proceedings of the Conference
pi1_resumen: Interaction-level BiLSTM encoder updates a discourse state per turn. Decoder attends over the last h previous utterances with relative position embeddings. p4-5 §3.2, p5 §3.3
pi2_resumen: A pointer-generator decoder copies tokens from the previous predicted SQL, encoded by a BiLSTM, or generates new ones. A copy switch p_copy mixes the two distributions. p6 §3.4
pi3_resumen: Table embeddings concatenate column names with the table name. The guide predicts tables first through an intermediate SQL state with FROM first. It then prunes non-member columns and tables not FK-linked. p4 §3.1, p6-7 §3.5
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction mechanism.
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section or discussion. Authors only note that SParC and CoSQL test sets are unreleased, so evaluation is on dev only.

autores: Elgohary, A.; Hosseini, S.; Awadallah, A.H.
venue: Proceedings of the Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
pi1_resumen: Seq2Struct+Feedback concatenates the feedback to the question and does not use the wrong parse. EditSQL+Feedback treats question and feedback as two turns and forces the mispredicted parse as the turn-1 output (p.8).
pi2_resumen: The dialogue state is the previous (wrong) SQL, which EditSQL edits, conditioned on the question and feedback. There are only two turns and no explicit state structure is proposed.
pi3_resumen: There is no dedicated linking module. Only the handcrafted re-ranker string-matches schema items against the feedback. The error analysis finds that joins are the most error-prone edits (p.5 Sec.4.1).
pi4_resumen: A user reads a template-based NL explanation of the wrong SQL and gives free-form feedback of up to 15 tokens. A correction model then generates the fixed parse in one round (p.3-4, p.8).
limitaciones_autores: Best model reaches only 25.1% against an estimated 81.5% human accuracy. Only a single correction turn is covered, and multi-turn correction is left as future work. There is no dedicated limitations section.

pi2_resumen: CD-Seq2Seq propaga un estado de discurso con un LSTM de nivel turno; SyntaxSQL-con usa solo la pregunta inmediatamente anterior (p.7-8 §5.1-5.2; p.8 análisis Tabla 6).
pi3_resumen: No se reporta vinculación de esquema explícita ni inferencia de joins; el esquema se codifica como embeddings de columnas (p.7 §5.1).
pi4_resumen: No hay retroalimentación de ejecución ni autocorrección en los modelos evaluados (p.7-8 §5).
limitaciones_autores: Nota al pie: menos de 10 ejemplos de answer refinement/theme en los 102 analizados, se necesitan más para generalizar. No hay sección de limitaciones.

pi1_resumen: Baselines take all previous questions plus the system clarification for affirmed ambiguous questions. CD-Seq2Seq can copy segments of previously generated SQL. p.7 §5.1
pi2_resumen: Dialogue state is defined as the SQL query for each user utterance, predicted from the interaction context and schema without gold previous SQL. The baselines are existing SParC models applied unchanged. p.7 §5.1
pi3_resumen: No explicit schema linking or join inference. Schema information is encoded within the baseline models. p.7 §5.1
pi4_resumen: Clarification and ambiguity are in the data and user dialogue-act prediction (baseline only). Authors state they do not study how a system clarifies. p.9 §7
limitaciones_autores: Clarification quality is not evaluated; questions needing non-SQL logical reasoning are excluded; the response generation task covers only CONFIRM_SQL turns. p.7 §5; p.9 §7

titulo: Editing-based SQL query generation for cross-domain context-dependent questions
autores: Zhang, R.; Yu, T.; Er, H.Y.; Shim, S.; Xue, E.; Lin, X.V.; Shi, T.; Xiong, C.; Socher, R.; Radev, D.
venue: EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019 - 2019 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing and 9th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing, Proceedings of the Conference
pi1_resumen: Turn attention (dot-product) over previous utterance embeddings is added to the current utterance embedding. Previous utterances are also attended to in the decoder; the previous query is used via editing (p.4 §3.2, p.5 §3.3).
pi2_resumen: The previous predicted query is encoded with a bi-LSTM. The decoder attends to it and a copy/insert switch (p_copy) edits it token by token. A unidirectional LSTM interaction encoder carries the history (p.4 §3.2; p.5-6 §3.4).
pi3_resumen: Column headers (table.column) are encoded with a bi-LSTM and self-attention over headers (foreign-key structure). Co-attention with utterance tokens makes the representation depend on the utterance. Joins are not handled explicitly (p.3 §3.1).
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction. Robustness to error propagation comes from token-level editing, not from a correction loop.
limitaciones_autores: No explicit limitations section. Authors note that error propagation limits editing gains without BERT (only ~1.5% gain) and that gold-query editing is an unrealistic oracle.

limitaciones_autores: El feedback es generado por un LLM, no por usuarios reales, así que no se sabe si los resultados se mantienen con feedback humano. Hace falta un benchmark conversacional crowdsourced dividido en historial y preguntas nuevas. Ubicación: p.6 §4.

pi4_resumen: The LLM either refines the query or shows the user disambiguation options, using retrieved domain knowledge. There is no SQL execution-based correction in NL2SQL; the Data Insight agents use execution feedback. p.4, p.6.
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section. Only discusses why production accuracy exceeds benchmark accuracy, and that MRD-BIRD lacks user interaction for clarification.

pi1_resumen: Partial follow-up queries are classified into labels, which are combined with retained labels from earlier turns to add/modify filters and facets. The user can reset the context.
pi2_resumen: The dialogue state is the set of clause labels from the classifier, updated iteratively at each turn. Post-processing merges it with new labels.
pi3_resumen: Solr index over distinct values and synonyms tags WHERE particles and canonicalizes synonyms. Clause classifiers map phrases to schema attributes. FROM is inferred from referenced attributes.
pi4_resumen: No automatic execution-feedback correction. The system shows a confidence score and lets users edit the generated SQL, and it checks syntax with a SQL parser.
limitaciones_autores: No dedicated limitations section. Lessons learned note that the system is domain-specific with little value in generalizing, depends on seed data and privileged-user configuration, and that user expectations must be managed.

limitaciones_autores: Noisy crowdsourced action labels (low Abg-CoQA agreement 0.26) and the assumption that clarification is well timed. Task-specific heuristics need engineering. Heavy reliance on commercial LLMs (Gemini) for annotation and simulation. Only the limited-data regime was tested. ACT is only quasi-online.

pi3_resumen: El linking lo hace la atención con relaciones de RASAT, basada en coincidencia de cadenas y claves foráneas. SE-HCL solo añade o borra columnas y tablas irrelevantes como aumento de datos (p.4, p.6).
pi4_resumen: No hay retroalimentación de ejecución ni autocorrección. La perplejidad del modelo solo puntúa la dificultad de los datos y decide cuándo parar el entrenamiento (p.5).

pi2_resumen: The state tracker updates the current alignment matrix with attention over the previous round's alignment matrix. It is supervised by schema-link annotations through an auxiliary loss. p.9-10 §3.3.
pi3_resumen: Explicit N-gram alignment is fused with a correlation-based implicit alignment matrix, via a learnable weight, inside relation-aware self-attention. Joins are left to the model. p.11-12 §3.4.
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction mechanism.
limitaciones_autores: Single dataset (CHASE), so limited generalisability across languages and domains. Reliance on pretrained Ernie. Extra computational complexity. Quality of the alignment matrix limits implicit relations. Underperforms IGSQL on complex queries.

limitaciones_autores: Los errores restantes se deben a múltiples errores en una consulta, a la incapacidad de interpretar el feedback o a feedback desalineado. El estudio con usuarios queda para trabajo futuro. Evaluación preliminar y pequeña (101 y 54 ejemplos).

pi1_resumen: Dialogue state tracking predicts the current SUQL query q_n from the schema, the previous (A_i,U_i) pairs and the latest utterance t_n. A first LLM stage decides whether the corpus must be consulted (p.4 §4). No dedicated context-restoration step is described.
pi2_resumen: The state is the plain history of utterances plus the predicted SUQL queries, and the LLM predicts the new query from it. No state structure and no context-growth treatment is reported.
pi3_escala_esquema: Yelp: 1 tabla, 11 columnas, 1828 restaurantes; HybridQA: ~13,000 tablas pequeñas consultadas por separado (máximo de columnas por tabla NR)
pi3_resumen: Free-text columns are linked through dense retrieval, with an LLM verifying the filter. ENUM values with more than 10 options are mapped by an LLM CLASSIFY that overloads '='. No schema-linking recall is reported.
pi4_resumen: The HybridQA pipeline retries SUQL generation up to 2 times when execution returns no result. The conversational agent has no retry and tells the user what it searched, plus 'no results found' when empty.
limitaciones_autores: Depends on the LLM: its semantic understanding bounds parsing and ANSWER/SUMMARY quality, the parser can hallucinate database contents, API calls are nondeterministic, and the system is open to adversarial attacks.

pi1_resumen: A rewrite stage (Concat, Seq2Seq, RUN, or oracle gold rewrite) turns the history plus the current utterance into one self-contained utterance, which a single-turn RAT-SQL parses. Dataset annotations record co-reference/ellipsis categories and the rewrite trace (p.4-5 §4.1; p.9 §6.1).
pi2_resumen: There is no explicit dialogue state. Context is carried either as the concatenated history (Concat) or as a rewritten self-contained utterance. The rewriter is a neural model and context cost is not discussed (p.9 §6.1.2).
pi3_resumen: Linking is handled only by the off-the-shelf RAT-SQL (relation-aware layer between question tokens and tables/columns). It is not a contribution and is not evaluated separately (p.9 §6.1.3).
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction in the system. A pre-trained parser is used only to flag faulty rewrite annotations during dataset construction (p.6 §4.2.3).
limitaciones_autores: No dedicated limitations section. They note rewrite models still lag far behind the oracle upper bound, and that rewriters do not adapt across SParC/CoSQL dialogue formats without annotations. The dataset is not yet released.

pi1_resumen: Two strategies: full-history concatenation, and a GPT-4 Turbo rewriting module (GQR, temperature 0) that first decides whether context is needed, then rewrites the last question as a single-turn question. Weights of the two fine-tuned models are then averaged (alpha=0.5). Location: p.6 §3.3, Fig. 6; p.7 §3.4.
pi2_resumen: No explicit dialogue-state structure. Context is the flat concatenated history of questions and SQL, or a rewritten single-turn question. Input length grows with the number of turns (p.6-7 §3.3-3.4).
pi3_escala_esquema: Hasta 6 tablas y 10 columnas por contexto de esquema (entrenamiento); media 5.1 tablas/BD en los datasets
pi3_resumen: No dedicated schema-linking module. Prompts carry the full schema with FKs and n-gram-matched example values. The paper mentions schema linking only as future work (p.10 §5.4).
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction in the proposed system.
limitaciones_autores: Dev set used as proxy because the test sets are not public; ESM is strict and the annotations are ambiguous. GQR loses information or over-simplifies ambiguity. PLM baseline outputs vary between runs. Possible LLM memorization. Cross-validation is left as future work.

pi2_resumen: The state is a flat serialization of the previous questions plus the previous SQL, fed to a BART encoder. No explicit state structure or graph is built. (p.3 Fig.2; p.5 §3.3.3)
pi3_resumen: Name- and value-based fuzzy string matching adds match marks to the input. Table-relation marks encode the schema structure. After decoding, missing JOIN tables and columns are recovered with shortest paths on the schema graph. (p.4 §3.3; p.5 §3.5)
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction loop. Constrained decoding filters invalid schema tokens during beam search, and SQL completion is a post-processing step. (p.5 §3.4-3.5)
limitaciones_autores: The only limitation is an error case: inaccurate schema linking produces wrong structure marks and an unnecessary table. The authors say higher-precision structure marks would help. No dedicated limitations section.

pi1_resumen: All previous user utterances are concatenated with <s> boundary tokens together with the schema columns and fed to the encoder. There is no rewriting or explicit resolution (p.2 Sec.4.1).
pi2_resumen: The dialogue state is implicit in the encoder over the concatenated turns. The auxiliary TSP task (17 SQL-change types between adjacent turns) and the CSP task (11 per-column change types for the last turn) shape it (p.3 Sec.4.2-4.3).
pi3_resumen: Schema linking is delegated to RAT-SQL's relation-aware encoder. CSP additionally predicts, per column, how its usage changes in the last turn (p.3 Sec.4.3). No join-inference method or linking metrics are reported.

pi1_resumen: Un utterance encoder token-level con atencion multi-cabeza integra todos los enunciados previos en la representacion del enunciado actual; la ultima SQL predicha se usa para copiar tokens y extraer estados. Las respuestas del sistema se concatenan al enunciado con '|' (p.5 Eq.8-12; p.1 Fig.1).
pi2_resumen: Define schema-states (columnas con palabras clave SQL como valor) y SQL-states (palabras clave con columnas como valor), actualizados por reglas desde la ultima SQL predicha. Los schema-states se codifican con un RGNN sobre grafo FK/FKT y los SQL-states con una capa no lineal (p.4-5).
pi3_resumen: El schema linking es un modulo de atencion neuronal entre tokens del enunciado y schema-states, mas un RGNN sobre aristas FK y FK-table. Los joins no se predicen: FROM/JOIN/ON se rellenan con reglas simples no descritas (p.4 nota 1; p.5).
pi4_resumen: No hay retroalimentacion de ejecucion ni autocorreccion en el sistema.
limitaciones_autores: No hay seccion de limitaciones. Resultados de test de CoSQL solo del mejor modelo en dev por limite de envios; sin resultados de test en SParC por tiempo; trabajo futuro: mejorar la definicion y el seguimiento de estados.

pi1_resumen: Current utterance and dialog history are concatenated and encoded by the pre-trained encoder. The TCS objective teaches the encoder to predict the query difference between turns. p.2 §2.1, p.3 §2.2, p.4 §3
pi2_resumen: No explicit dialogue state. The encoder is pre-trained with TCS (26 context-switch labels) to capture flow between turns, over the flat history. p.3 §2.2
pi3_resumen: CCS pre-training predicts the operations (e.g. GROUPBY, HAVING, WHERE) applied to each schema column per turn, to align utterance and schema. Join inference is left to the base parser and is not discussed. p.3 §2.2
pi4_resumen: NA
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section. They note that the synthetic grammar was induced from SParC and may overfit to SParC, and that longer pre-training overfits to unnatural synthetic utterances. p.4 §3 ablation, p.8 App. C

titulo: FANDA: A novel approach to perform follow-up query analysis
autores: Liu, Q.; Chen, B.; Lou, J.-G.; Jin, G.; Zhang, D.
venue: 33rd AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, AAAI 2019, 31st Innovative Applications of Artificial Intelligence Conference, IAAI 2019 and the 9th AAAI Symposium on Educational Advances in Artificial Intelligence, EAAI 2019
pi1_resumen: Anonymizes the precedent and follow-up queries into symbols, groups them into SQL-clause-like segments, ranks segment/intent sequences with BiLSTM-CRF, and fuses the two queries by replacing or appending conflicting segments into a standalone natural-language fused query (p.3-5, Sec.3-4).
pi2_resumen: No dialogue state beyond the immediately preceding query; the pair is represented as symbol and segment sequences. Extension to multi-turn is explicitly left as future work (p.3-4, p.8).
pi3_escala_esquema: Una tabla por consulta; 120 tablas (≥8 filas, ≥1 columna numérica); máximo de columnas NR; multi-tabla como trabajo futuro
pi3_resumen: Column names and cell values are identified by simple string matching against the table during anonymization; single-table setting, no join inference (p.3, p.6).
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback or self-correction; execution accuracy is used only for evaluation by manually checking SQL from the downstream parser (p.6).
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section. Future work only: extend to multi-turn and multi-table settings; execution accuracy limited to 103 of 200 test triples parsable by Coarse2Fine.

titulo: Dynamic Hybrid Relation Network for Cross-Domain Context-Dependent Semantic Parsing
autores: Hui, B.; Geng, R.; Ren, Q.; Li, B.; Li, Y.; Sun, J.; Huang, F.; Si, L.; Zhu, P.; Zhu, X.
venue: 35th AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, AAAI 2021
pi1_resumen: All utterances of the conversation are concatenated with the schema into BERT, and an interaction-level LSTM merges turn embeddings. The decoder edits the previously predicted query. (p.3 Eq.1-4; p.5)
pi2_resumen: A schema-linking graph over context tokens and schema items is rebuilt each turn. Token- and utterance-level memory decay (gate or schedule) down-weights older turns in attention. (p.3-4)
pi3_resumen: Explicit relations (same table, foreign key, exact/n-gram match) enter relation-aware attention (DCRE). Implicit decayed cross-attention between utterance and schema (DCRI) complements them. No linking metrics are reported. (p.4)
pi4_resumen: No execution feedback. A BERT-based reranker rescores the beam-search N-best SQL candidates from the utterance, history and candidate SQL, using task-related and BERT features. (p.5)
limitaciones_autores: No limitations section. Only noted that the model is still affected by turn depth (accuracy drops as the conversation proceeds).
